whenToUse: Warehouse stock: value, reorder points, out-of-stock and days of cover per warehouse.
Turning a reorder queue into purchase orders and recording stock movements.
avoidWhen: Editing many prices and quantities at once — use list-10.
A single product's information — use detail-07.
a11y: The stock table exposes aria-sort on its sortable column; the cover histogram is role="img".
Keep the warehouse switch as a labelled control so the scope change is announced.
